item.title: Norwest Raises $4B Fund to Deepen AI Investing
item.description:
Norwest, backed solely by Wells Fargo, closed its 18th fund at $4 billion, the largest in its 65-year history. The capital will span the US, India and Israel across multiple sectors, with emphasis on physical AI, voice AI, agentic cybersecurity and aerospace.

item.title: Fireworks AI Breach Exposes Notion Customer Chat Data
item.description:
Fireworks AI confirmed that an attacker breached its cloud provider to compromise a development system, exposing some customer billing information and datasets. Notion disclosed that roughly 1% of its customers were affected, disconnected its systems from Fireworks on November 3, and deleted stored data. It marks the second security incident for Fireworks in two months.

原文标题：Fireworks AI 遭网络攻击 波及 Notion 约 1% 用户

Why it matters：主流开源模型推理平台发生数据泄露，直接波及下游客户，是 AI 基础设施供应链安全的典型警示案例。

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns, CFO Colette Kress Takes Interim Role
item.description:
Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO and left the board with immediate effect, ending more than 33 years at the helm. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO while retaining her finance role, and director Harvey Jones becomes the company's first board chair. The exit came three days after the board opened an outside probe into reports that Huang was a foreign intelligence target; shares fell about 10% pre-market, extending two-week losses to roughly $1.4 trillion. The next CEO will oversee over $100 billion in investments, including a planned $10 billion purchase of Anthropic shares at its IPO.

原文标题：黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 首席财务官 Kress 临时代任

Why it matters：全球市值最高芯片公司的最高层突发更替，直接牵动算力供应链与 AI 投资版图。

item.title: Google Unveils Privacy Safeguards for Android XR Smart Glasses
item.description:
Google has detailed a privacy framework for its first Android XR smart glasses built with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster: an outward-facing recording indicator that lights up only when content is saved, on-device face blurring, and Gemini camera frames that are deleted immediately and never used for training or ads. The measures are not technically novel, but they directly address consumer concerns in a market where rivals' privacy missteps have set a low bar.

原文标题：谷歌为 Android XR 眼镜推出隐私保护机制

Why it matters：谷歌首次系统披露 Android XR 眼镜的隐私设计细节，是智能眼镜能否被大众接受的关键变量。

item.title: Intangible 2.0 Launches Canvas for Directing AI-Generated 3D Scenes
item.description:
Intangible has launched version 2.0 with Canvas, an AI workspace that turns a written brief into a 3D scene with objects, references, lighting and cameras, while letting users move cameras and regenerate cinematic shots without breaking scene consistency. Users can connect Claude or other assistants to build and modify scenes and take over manually at any point; JetZero is already using it to visualize aircraft that have not yet flown.

item.description:

The drop narrowed to 7.51% by publication, underscoring how sharply markets reacted to the leadership change at the central supplier of AI compute.

item.title: PostgreSQL Ships Multi-Version Update Fixing 52 Security Flaws
item.description:
The PostgreSQL Global Development Group released maintenance updates for versions 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20 and 14.25 alongside PostgreSQL 19 RC 2, fixing 52 security vulnerabilities and over 140 bugs. PostgreSQL 14 reaches end-of-life with this final release, so production users should plan upgrades promptly.

Why it matters：一次覆盖五个分支的大规模安全修复，且 14 版本正式 EOL，对数据库运维者有直接行动价值。

item.title: LibreAGI Launches Private BitTorrent Tracker to Preserve Open Model Weights
item.description:
LibreAGI is a members-only private BitTorrent tracker where members seed copies of open model weights most likely to disappear, earning credit weighted by scarcity. It accepts only safetensors and GGUF files under Apache-2.0, MIT or the Qwen Community License, verifies each file against its source commit, and publishes a signed public catalog so the swarms can be rebuilt if the site goes away.

原文标题：LibreAGI 推出私有 BT 网络备份开源模型权重

Why it matters：以去中心化做种机制应对开源模型下架风险，是开源模型长期保存与分发的一次具体工程尝试。

item.title: JD.com Completes 1.335 Billion Euro Ceconomy Takeover
item.description:
JD.com has completed its tender offer for German consumer electronics retailer Ceconomy, acquiring 59.8% of shares and voting rights for EUR 1.335 billion and making Ceconomy a subsidiary. Combined with partner Convergenta's retained 25.3% stake, the two hold 85.2% of the company. Ceconomy operates over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores across 11 countries, and JD.com says it will keep independent operations and its local technology stack unchanged.
